999008199.text: お見事お見事。相変わらず、いい腕してるね

localizations.en: Excellent work as always. You haven't lost your touch.

999008199.text:
いや……この程度ではまだ鏑矢様を
守って差し上げることなど叶わぬ

localizations.en: No... This level of skill still won't be enough to protect Lady Kaburaya.

999008199.text: 真面目だなぁ、そこが素敵なところなんだけど

localizations.en: Take it easy... though your dedication is part of your charm.

999008199.text: す、すごい！　今のが忍術！？

どうやったんですか！？
鬼門さん、アタシにも忍術を教えてください！

localizations.en: How did you do it?! Please teach me ninjutsu too!

999008199.text:
……忍びの道は修羅の道、僭越ながら
生半可な気持ちで歩まれないほうがよろしいかと

localizations.en: The ninja's path is one of hardship. I humbly suggest you not walk it with half-hearted resolve.

999008199.text:
忍びは闇より生じ、闇に溶けゆく……
姓も無く、名を授けし主のためだけの存在……

localizations.en: Ninja are born from darkness and fade into darkness... Without family name, existing only for the master who grants them purpose...

999008199.text: その一生を主に捧げる覚悟がなければ務まりませぬ

localizations.en: Without the resolve to dedicate one's entire life to their master, one cannot fulfill this duty.

999008199.text: うっ……それはちょっと、アタシには無理かも……

localizations.en: Ugh... That might be a bit much for me...

999008199.text: それなら私が姉様の忍者に……シュシュッと

localizations.en: Then perhaps I could become Alvina's ninja... SWOOSH...

999008199.text: ダメよ。あなたの天命は聖戦士でしょ

localizations.en: Absolutely not. Your divine calling is as a Sacred Knight.

999008199.text:
そこまで覚悟して命がけで動いてるから
ケイウンの忍者はすごいって噂にもなるんだろうね

localizations.en: With that level of dedication, it's no wonder that Keiun's ninjas have such an incredible reputations.

999008199.text:
でも、ちょっと窮屈そうだよね……
我慢とかしてませんか？

localizations.en: But it seems a little strict... don't you think so?

999008199.text:
ふふっ……鏑矢様も昔、似たようなことを
言ってくださいました

localizations.en: Hehe... Lady Kaburaya once said something similar.

999008199.text:
拙者はただ、鏑矢様がご無事で、拙者のことを
覚えてくださっていれば、幸せでございまする

localizations.en: For me, as long as Lady Kaburaya stays safe, I am content.

999008199.text:
なればこそ、鏑矢様をたぶらかしたコウセンを
許すことはできませぬ……！

localizations.en: That's precisely why I cannot forgive Kosen for deceiving her...!
